NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 128

He can't be... He must be... 他不可能…… 他肯定是……

他不可能…… 他肯定是……

A picture lesson on the modal verbs for deduction: 'can't be' (negative certainty) and 'must be' (positive certainty). Eight pictures show deductions about a man's condition, a hat, a woman's nationality, a man's job, ages, a date, family birth order and what a man is doing. The lesson introduces written exercises on rewriting 'must' sentences with 'has to' or 'I think he is probably...', and writing new sentences with 'can't be' and 'must be'. The workbook drills writing deductions with 'can't be' and 'must be' and agreeing with tag questions; the grammar workbook completes sentences with 'can't' or 'must' and answers questions following the model.

01

READ & UNDERSTAND

Lesson 课文

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

1. He can't be ill. He must be tired.
2. It can't be my new hat. It must be my old one.
3. She can't be Danish. She must be Swedish.
4. He can't be a dentist. He must be a doctor.
5. She can't be forty. She must be fifty.
6. It can't be the 20th. It must be the 21st.
7. He can't be the youngest. He must be the oldest.
8. He can't be reading. He must be sleeping.

1. 他不可能生病了。他肯定是累了。
2. 那不可能是我的新帽子。那肯定是我的旧帽子。
3. 她不可能丹麦人。她肯定是瑞典人。
4. 他不可能牙医。他肯定是医生。
5. 她不可能四十岁。她肯定五十岁了。
6. 那不可能是二十号。那肯定是二十一号。
7. 他不可能是最小的。他肯定是最老的。
8. 他不可能在阅读。他肯定在睡觉。

Listen and answer the questions

Listen to the tape and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

听录音并回答问题。

One question per picture (8 pictures); the answer is the spoken deduction from the picture captions.

New words & expressions 生词和短语

dentist /'dentist/
n. 牙医
probably /'prɔbəbli/
adv. 很可能，大概

Written A: Rewrite these sentences

模仿例句，使用 has to 或 I think he is probably... 改写以下句子。

模仿例句，使用 has to 或 I think he is probably... 改写以下句子。

7 rewrite items; 2 examples printed on the page (He must be home before six o'clock. → He has to be home before six o'clock. He must be tired. → I think he is probably tired.).

Written B: Write new sentences

模仿例句改写下列句子。

模仿例句改写下列句子。

20 rewrite items; 1 example printed on the page (I think she's Danish. (Swedish) → I don't think so. She can't be Danish. She must be Swedish.).
